Photocell.label: Photocell
Photocell.description: A uCIFI photocell object is used for lighting control, particularly to identify when light should be switched ON/OFF.

ON_lux_level.label: ON lux level
ON_lux_level.description: Lux level below which the photocell switches its relay ON or sends a switch ON message on the network.

OFF_lux_level.label: OFF lux level
OFF_lux_level.description: Lux level above which the photocell switches its relay OFF or sends a switch OFF message on the network.

Photocell_status.label: Photocell status
Photocell_status.description: Set to True if lux level is below ON lux level. Set to False if lux level is above OFF lux.
